goals.title: Summarize the offline fixture evidence.
goals.brief:
Recurring quick check: Summarize the offline fixture evidence.

Expected result: A short report with sources.

Give the smallest complete answer, not a research report. Do not send messages, publish, trade, delete files, or change external systems.

steps.title: Answer the recurring question
steps.instructions:
Answer this recurring question directly with current, verifiable sources: Summarize the offline fixture evidence.

Follow the occurrence time window; never substitute today for it. Give the value(s) or short result and its as-of time, 2–5 original links, and at most one or two material caveats. Do not add an appendix, methodology, background history, scenario analysis or next steps unless the task explicitly asks for them. If a value cannot be verified, name it and the reason in one sentence. Separate observed facts from inference. Expected result: A short report with sources.
